scientific_integrity: Analytical universal proof and executable exact arithmetic checks; no independent review or peer validation.
scientific_limitations: Uniform weighted windmills, exactly two noise-free leaders, unnormalized trace. The 2020 windmill leader-coherence paper could only be examined by abstract; exact overlap is a residual originality risk. The known unit-weight case is not claimed separately as new.
title: Two-leader coherence transitions in weighted clique windmills
